title: Re-Establish
summary: RE-ESTAB'LISH, verb transitive [re and establish.] To establish anew; to fix or confirm again; as, to re-establish a covenant; to re-establish health.

inlines.v: RE-ESTAB'LISH, verb transitive [re and establish.] To establish anew; to fix or confirm again; as, to re-establish a covenant; to re-establish health.
